new_value.evidence_summary: Breakage analysis: (1) HyperCore L1 halts → StakingManager L1Write calls revert → no new stakes or unstakes; reward settlement stops and the exchange rate freezes at its last value. (2) Operator stoppage leaves validator performance scores stale and stops StakeHub rebalancing. (3) A malicious authorized DefaultOracle adapter could submit false performance scores. (4) Pausing OracleManager halts performance updates while the rate calculation continues using existing inputs. These are documented dependency and operational risks rather than an undisclosed integration.
